'''Griff Praji''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the wealthy and influential [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They had two younger brothers, [[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon]] and [[Tannon Praji's brother|another brother]]. Their [[Tannon Praji's mother|mother]] instilled an appreciation for culture and the fine arts on the brothers. The family often took vacations off of Coruscant including to [[Museum/Legends|museums]]<ref name="Tinker" /> on the planet<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|III|38|Porus Vida}}</ref> [[Porus Vida]] and the [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]] ruins in the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]].<ref name="Tinker" />

Griff's son, [[Nahdonnis Praji]], was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]].<ref name="Tinker" /> Later in [[104 ABY]],<ref name="blog">The last section of ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'' is titled "''Inheritance (10&ndash;104 ABY)''". {{Blog|valinkenobi|14/comments|TTSP Endnotes: Volume 1}} states that the [[in-universe]] article was published in 104 ABY.</ref> the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Academician|Dr.]] [[Gabrel Treon]] mentioned Griff briefly in his article about House Praji titled: "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]."<ref name="Tinker" />

==Behind the scenes==
Griff Praji was mentioned in [[Nathan O'Keefe]]'s ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive [[in-universe]] history article published on [[February 5]] [[2009]].<ref name="Tinker" />
